description: Module graph for the xf-thread-tools build: pure ESM modules (importable, unit-tested) and order-preserving runtime fragments (slices of main()'s body sharing its scope). scripts/build.mjs consumes this manifest; scripts/split.mjs used it for the one-time split from the single-file script. docs/MODULES.md is generated from this file.

pureModules.name: config
pureModules.desc: Storage keys, default settings (delays, caps, AI opts), BASE_SEL selector defaults. No functions, no DOM.

pureModules.name: parse
pureModules.desc: Pure parsing/classification: reaction-count text (EN/VI), link filtering, link partition/group/filter, post sorting, size estimation.

pureModules.name: media
pureModules.desc: Pure media classification and resolution helpers: image/video extension gates, smilie + boilerplate fingerprint, image landing-page parse, HQ .md/.th candidate chain, album page/API parse.

pureModules.name: embed
pureModules.desc: Pure video-host carriers: embed poster parse, sign-endpoint URL/response shapes, view-API parse, video file-page carrier parse, /v/ /f/ /d/ URL shapes.

pureModules.name: zip
pureModules.desc: Pure zip writer (STORE method, hand-rolled, CRC32, LE helpers, headers, EOCD) + naming: segment sanitize, site tag, thread title cleaning, kind tag, outer/entry file names.

pureModules.name: dlplan
pureModules.desc: Pure download planning: job list from media items (dedup, seq-prefixed names, kind routing), chunk plans for Range parts, failure classification, per-origin burst verdict from rolling history.

pureModules.name: layout
pureModules.desc: Pure grid math: exact spacer metrics, window binary search, speed/ETA formatting, media layout entries (grouping headers + 4-cell rows).

pureModules.name: ai
pureModules.desc: Pure AI helpers: htmlToText, transcript builder (query-boosted, budgeted), system prompts (en/vi), endpoint/base/native-chat URL math, context stats, model/reply parsers, markdown tokenizer/renderer core, SSE+NDJSON stream parser.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-settings
runtimeFragments.desc: GM storage read/write, AI key storage (GM-only), settings load/merge, selector merge (SEL), sleep/route/threadId/threadKey helpers, page-number readers.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-hub
runtimeFragments.desc: Shared thread state hub (meta, fetch progress) + record version/pos-map/sorter-pending state.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-extract
runtimeFragments.desc: Record ordering/positions, URL absolutize, lazy body HTML, extractPost (media/links/imgPages/albums, quote+signature skip), doc extraction, live-page seed, size measurement.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-cache
runtimeFragments.desc: IndexedDB wrapper (posts/threads stores, cap handling, fallback), cachePutPosts, threadUrl builder.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-fetch
runtimeFragments.desc: Sequential page fetch engine with retries/leash, partial resume set, ensure/ensureForSort paths.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-sorter
runtimeFragments.desc: Sort button state, post clone builder, reaction sorter (reorder, chunked Show more, restore).

runtimeFragments.name: rt-grid
runtimeFragments.desc: Panel element handles, virtualizer (pool, sig rows, reconcile, renderSlice, mount, clearVRows), tiny/broken media state, pop suppress + broken-rerender debounce. NOTE: 'panel' here is the first `let panel` handle declaration; fragment spans through scheduleBrokenRerender.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-posters
runtimeFragments.desc: Embed poster cache (GM storage), queued poster fetch net (2/350ms, backoff, cooldown), ensureEmbedPoster.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-embednet
runtimeFragments.desc: Embed stream cache, gmGetText/gmPostJson (GM XHR + fetch fallback), resolveEmbedStream (sign endpoint / view API / file-page carriers).

runtimeFragments.name: rt-imgpage
runtimeFragments.desc: Image landing-page HQ resolution: session cache, cooldown, queued net (2/350ms), inflight dedup, force path for viewer/downloads.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-albums
runtimeFragments.desc: Album expansion runtime: GM-storage store (TTL, prune), HTML/API walk, albumDone rerender, ensureAlbum lazy trigger.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-viewstate
runtimeFragments.desc: View state (tab/subtab/scroll memory per view), viewer state vars, render queue flag, mkBtn button helper.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-failpolicy
runtimeFragments.desc: Failure policy: origin stats/verdicts, stall state + ladder + recovery queue, retire, animate-out, mark loaded, viewer img slot sizing, HQ stage/retry memory.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-download
runtimeFragments.desc: Download engine: run state, two-level net pools (files/connections), chunked transfers, retries/leashes/watchdog, zip assembly + save, dashboard UI, startBulkDownload.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-media
runtimeFragments.desc: Media element builders: tile poster attach (event-time cell resolve), loadSwapImg (referer policy + cache-bust retry), buildMediaEl (loading gate, HQ swap, album thumbs).

runtimeFragments.name: rt-chrome
runtimeFragments.desc: Panel chrome updates: progress text, render scheduling, tab/subtab switching + counts, viewer open/close, jumpTo.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-render
runtimeFragments.desc: Panel data pipeline: render signature, panelData/collectMediaItems (dedup, album children, badges), renderPanelBody (all tabs, virtualized grid mount, links rows, scroll memory).

runtimeFragments.name: rt-settingsview
runtimeFragments.desc: Settings form (numeric fields, base path, animations toggle).

runtimeFragments.name: rt-aitab
runtimeFragments.desc: AI tab runtime: chat state (aiSeq rebuild guard), aiRequest (GM stream + fallback), send/dispatch (SEARCH protocol), test connection, markdown DOM renderer, renderAiTab.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-panel
runtimeFragments.desc: Panel shell: anim override, open/close, count-only updates, scroll/resize watches, filter controls, links bar, edge button, settings toggle, buildPanel.

runtimeFragments.name: rt-boot
runtimeFragments.desc: Toolbar injection, embedded CSS (token system), boot IIFE (progress init, autoFetch kick).
